## Timeline Test

::: {.timeline style="--timeline-items: 5;"}
::: {.timeline-item}
::: {.timeline-card}
<span class="timeline-date">Step 1</span>
<span class="timeline-title">Observe</span>
<span class="timeline-note">Collect material traces, measurements, or spatial patterns.</span>
:::
:::

::: {.timeline-item}
::: {.timeline-card}
<span class="timeline-date">Step 2</span>
<span class="timeline-title">Summarise</span>
<span class="timeline-note">Inspect ranges, centres, spread, and obvious anomalies.</span>
:::
:::

::: {.timeline-item}
::: {.timeline-card}
<span class="timeline-date">Step 3</span>
<span class="timeline-title">Model</span>
<span class="timeline-note">Represent assumptions about how the observations were generated.</span>
:::
:::

::: {.timeline-item}
::: {.timeline-card}
<span class="timeline-date">Step 4</span>
<span class="timeline-title">Infer</span>
<span class="timeline-note">Estimate latent quantities and uncertainty from observed data.</span>
:::
:::

::: {.timeline-item}
::: {.timeline-card}
<span class="timeline-date">Step 5</span>
<span class="timeline-title">Interpret</span>
<span class="timeline-note">Connect model output back to archaeological process.</span>
:::
:::
:::

::: {.fragment}

The number of columns is controlled by `--timeline-items`.

:::

## Vertical Timeline Test

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="30%"}

Use this version when:

- labels are longer
- the sequence has many steps
- you want a stronger reading order

:::

::: {.column width="70%"}

::: {.timeline-vertical}
::: {.timeline-item}
::: {.timeline-card}
<span class="timeline-date">Before fieldwork</span>
<span class="timeline-title">Research design</span>
<span class="timeline-note">Define the archaeological question and identify what must be observed.</span>
:::
:::

::: {.timeline-item}
::: {.timeline-card}
<span class="timeline-date">Data collection</span>
<span class="timeline-title">Material evidence</span>
<span class="timeline-note">Record measurements, spatial traces, contexts, and uncertainty.</span>
:::
:::

::: {.timeline-item}
::: {.timeline-card}
<span class="timeline-date">Analysis</span>
<span class="timeline-title">Model structure</span>
<span class="timeline-note">Connect observed traces to latent processes through explicit assumptions.</span>
:::
:::

::: {.timeline-item}
::: {.timeline-card}
<span class="timeline-date">Interpretation</span>
<span class="timeline-title">Historical inference</span>
<span class="timeline-note">Translate estimates and uncertainty into archaeological explanation.</span>
:::
:::
:::

## Reuse Pattern

Use this block in any slide:

```markdown
::: {.timeline style="--timeline-items: 4;"}
::: {.timeline-item}
::: {.timeline-card}
<span class="timeline-date">Date</span>
<span class="timeline-title">Event title</span>
<span class="timeline-note">Short interpretation.</span>
:::
:::
:::
```

The styles live in the `Timeline utilities` section of `mpg.scss`.
